lineage.parent_science: Ygg TRAIN negative 0/48; Wingless selected 33/48 versus control 33/48 on first DEV; both negative. Retain complete evidence, no retrospective retuning.
lineage.reuse_rule: Reuse parent source construction and authenticated baseline weights only by exact commit plus blob/raw identity; refuse drift. Reuse qualified focused evidence only under exact semantic input and harness identity; perform one required final full regression.

new_source.construction: Use unchanged first-admitted source-only paired graph constructor, original 4 structural families, 24 symmetric observed demonstrations with exactly 3 corrupted output bits, fixed vector sets and exact 48 positive/negative pairs per split per lane; rebind only the frozen operator/cohort identities.
new_source.source_oracle: Operator identity, true inverse, positive/negative truth and source graph partner remain evaluator-only, and are never model inputs.
new_source.DEV_gate: Do not instantiate, inspect, or score new DEV cohorts until a source-authenticated TRAIN-only artifact has been retained, a qualified preflight has passed and immutable single-selection receipt was committed before first use. No DEV retries, reseeding or post-result tuning.

Yggdrasil.scientific_question: Can a learnable cross-task relation binder acquire an unseen inverse composition from raw public input/output demonstrations without a supplied affine/Feistel operator grammar, rather than reverting to all-abstain or mnemonic shortcuts?
precommitted_mechanisms: amortized_support_attention: learned latent input/output bit-binding from multiple TRAIN tasks, adapted only from each task's 20 public FIT demonstrations
contrastive_relation_binding: shared learned cross-bit relational representation trained on TRAIN-derived positives and negatives with partner labels evaluator-only
bounded_recurrent_inverse: fixed-depth learned iterative relation refinement using public demonstrations only, not oracle-class templates
Yggdrasil.candidate_budget: Exactly these 3 mechanism families, 2 fixed model width settings each (8 and 16), using predetermined deterministic initialization keys; no expansion after first TRAIN result.
Yggdrasil.learning: Only prospective new TRAIN task examples and permitted paired TRAIN supervision. No operator name, source true inverse, evaluator class, sealed DEV or future query during support adaptation.
Yggdrasil.resource_census: Account explicitly for all learned shared weights, public support storage, task adaptation, intermediate activations, Python heap, RSS, CPU and inference wall time; extra task memory never masquerades as the 16 original cognitive cells.
Yggdrasil.TRAIN_eligibility: Positive sensitivity on at least one paired case, zero false positives, and strictly more paired-correct cases than the strongest eligible learned comparator on exactly the same fresh TRAIN cohort. Prefer least compute and memory after scientific gates.
Yggdrasil.DEV_success: One prospective first-use of unchanged frozen winner only: zero false positives, meaningful positive sensitivity, paired correctness greater than all eligible learned controls on same cohort and full resource disclosures; if not, retain negative.
Yggdrasil.interpretation: Learned representation improvement does not establish open-ended cognition, and source-only ceiling is not a model competitor.

Wingless.scientific_question: Can calibrated multi-hop causal evidence from raw intermediate handoffs selectively reject false positives while retaining long-chain positives under one 12-bit packed state per node, without costs eclipsing the gain?
precommitted_mechanisms: train_calibrated_hop_likelihood: train-only calibration of handoff mismatch statistics accumulated in the existing packed score
relative_counterfactual_prefix: local counterfactual alternative evidence aggregated into the existing packed state with no retained alternative path cache
Wingless.candidate_budget: Each mechanism uses exactly three frozen nonzero penalty levels 0.02, 0.06 and 0.12, plus unchanged gamma0; 7 total candidates.
Wingless.evaluation: All candidates and baseline see identical source/evaluator-normalized public graph inputs; the true inverse stays outside the model; count transient index and all model-only work.
Wingless.TRAIN_eligibility: Preserve individually every gamma0 accepted 13–15 hop positive; strictly reduce false positives; do not reduce paired-correct count. Tie prefers lower resource cost then unchanged control.
Wingless.DEV_success: Preserve individually all original gamma0 accepted long-chain positives, strictly fewer false positives than gamma0 and paired-correct count not below gamma0 on first prospective unseen DEV; report costs and deny equal-cost superiority when additional work increases.
Wingless.resource_census: Same-run model-only operations, CPU, wall, Python heap and OS RSS for selected and strongest comparators; exclude and disclose source-only normalization overhead equally.
